items.title: 68190_Samuel
items.q: Were there many political figures present like Pendergast Pentakast or his brother or any of those; McElroy, any of those?

ctx.x: Yes. We had -- well sort of a military-like funeral. This whole band that was created by Thamon Hayes after the Mo ten band, you know, shelled these others out, well this particular band was called upon to stand in intervals at the head and foot of Benny's casket; two men would stand all during the ceremony, would stand at the ends of the casket until the funeral -- the service was over and after this, well Benny was buried but as I say, it was one of the largest funerals that Kansas City had seen.
Were there many political figures present like Pendergast Pentakast or his brother or any of those; McElroy, any of those?
Well, maybe one or two. Benny wasn't so much of a politician.
